answer: Each agent claims one identity with a refundable 50 POA bond locked for 90 days. That bond cannot be split or shared, so 1,000 fakes would tie up 50,000 POA. A quartz key signs each claim and cannot be copied for parallel identities. Independent auditors, picked at random, keep a mirror copy of the bond ledger and check one key to one agent. A failed check slashes the full bond and removes the identities. The bond returns only after a 30-day voyage of checkable work.
